line-systolic.note: locked chart-series color, not a synthesized ramp — light/dark are the two real theme values

cat-normal.note: locked AHA clinical category; also reused as the Command Bar's 'listening' color

display.purpose: App title and hero stat values (StatsStrip avg tiles, reading count) only.

headline.purpose: Section headings — dialog titles, empty-state heading, field-set legends.

label.purpose: Every button, toggle, filter chip, and form label. The most-used named size in the codebase.

body.purpose: Running copy, table cells, helper/error text. Also the 18px accessibility floor — never go smaller.

shadows.name: elevation
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Marks card-like 'island' surfaces (stat tiles, dialogs, tooltips, banners, overlay-toggle buttons); the full-width command/filter bands stay flat.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only accent-filled surface in the app — submit actions, 'Show all data', 'Apply', 'Send', 'Log out' confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-text); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } /* no :hover treatment — the system deliberately has none; every interaction is tap/click, not hover */

components.name: Secondary / Filter Toggle Button
components.description: Inactive-vs-pressed filter/toggle control (FilterBar, OverlayToggle). Pressed state reuses the Primary button's accent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-sky); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-text); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header Chrome Button
components.description: Header utility controls (theme, Voice Replies, Guide, Upload, Log out) — icon + text, never accent-filled even when pressed, at the smaller 8px radius that quietly distinguishes them from primary app surfaces.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn-chrome" aria-pressed="false"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 7v14"/><path d="M3 18a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h5a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 4 4 0 0 1 4-4h5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v13a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-6a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0-3-3z"/></svg>Guide</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-chrome { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-sky); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-chrome:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } /* stays sky/ink even when aria-pressed='true' — chrome controls are never accent-filled, that fill is reserved for primary/filter actions */

components.name: Icon-Only Mic Button
components.description: The one icon-only control in the app (Command Bar mic toggle) — justified by a real aria-label that swaps with state.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Start voice control"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19v3"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2"/><rect x="9" y="2" width="6" height="13" rx="3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; width: 48px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-foam); color: var(--color-ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: Manual-entry form field (LabFields, DateRangePicker, CommandBar). Foam fill so it reads as a distinct well against the Sky card it usually sits inside.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Test name<input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="e.g. A1C, Cholesterol panel"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-foam); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Clinical Category Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped, always solid-colored (even inactive) since the color itself is clinical information, not decoration. Example shown: Normal.
components.css: .ds-chip-category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--cat-normal); color: var(--cat-chip-text); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } /* an active/selected chip additionally gets box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-ink) — a ring, not an outline, so :focus-visible's own outline stays independently visible */

components.name: Stat Tile Card
components.description: The Elevation token's canonical use — a Sky card floating on the flat Foam page, showing a Display-size hero number.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-sky); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevation); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card-detail { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview:
CardioStream is a two-tone sea-and-sky surface — Foam and Sky in the light theme, deepening to near-black water in Night Sea — with a single warm signal color, Terracotta, allowed to interrupt it. That restraint is not incidental: the system's own locked decisions state that warmth comes from the accent color alone, never from typographic voice or editorial copy, which is explicitly rejected as a source of personality here. The dashboard's job is to be read correctly and operated confidently by someone who cannot point a mouse or grip a stylus — legibility and calm outrank charm at every choice point.

The nautical motif (a sailboat mark, a wave-curve divider under the header) is confirmed decorative-only: it never sits behind data, and it is never the thing a user has to interpret. What the system does ask the eye to interpret — the six-step clinical color scale, the three overlay-dataset hues, the reserved Terracotta — is treated as information, not decoration, and is locked accordingly.
keyCharacteristics: One reserved accent (Terracotta) carries all of the system's visual warmth and marks every primary action and pressed/active state; nothing else is ever accent-filled.
A dedicated focus color, distinct from the accent, so a keyboard or switch-access focus ring never blends into an accent-filled control.
Six locked clinical BP-category colors and three locked overlay-dataset colors that encode medical/data meaning and are never adjusted for taste.

Flat, edge-to-edge full-width bands (header, command bar, filter bar) at zero elevation, punctuated by discrete elevated 'islands' — stat tiles, dialogs, tooltips — that alone use the system's one ambient shadow.
Every state change reads as a word + icon + color triad, never color alone; all motion is gated behind motion-safe:/motion-reduce: pairs.

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Every color used anywhere in the app is a CSS custom property declared once, for both themes, in index.css. Components consume var(--...) and never hardcode a hex value or invent a new one inline.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only color allowed to mean "act here" or "this is active." A control that isn't a primary action or a pressed state stays Ink-on-Sky, no matter how important it feels.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Locked Rule
rules.body: Clinical, overlay, and chart-series colors are medical/data identity, not palette decoration. A redesign may touch Foam, Sky, Ink, Terracotta, or Focus; it does not touch these three families without a deliberate, documented decision.

rules.name: The 18px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text in the product renders below 18px. This is a hard accessibility floor (--text-base), not a starting point to shrink from on dense screens.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 700 are used, matching the two static font files actually shipped. Never introduce an intermediate weight — the browser would fake it.

rules.name: The No-Off-Screen Rule
rules.body: Interactive rows wrap (flex-wrap) rather than scroll or clip. A caregiver using a phone one-handed never has to scroll sideways to find a control.

rules.name: The Flat-Sea Rule
rules.body: Command and filter surfaces never cast a shadow — only discrete card-like 'islands' do. If a new surface is a control band spanning the full width, it stays flat; if it's a self-contained card or dialog, it gets the one elevation token.

rules.name: The Dashed-Border Rule
rules.body: A disabled or not-yet-valid action gets a 2px dashed Ink border, not a lowered-opacity solid one. The border style itself carries the "not ready" meaning.

dos: Do keep Terracotta to its reserved list — primary actions and pressed/active states only.
Do pair every state change with a word and/or icon, never color alone.
Do hold every interactive target to 48×48px minimum, unless it's one of the six explicitly documented discreet header-utility controls.
Do gate any new motion behind motion-safe:/motion-reduce: pairs, with a static fallback (a ring, not a spin) for the reduced-motion case.
Do reach for xl (12px) radius on any new card, dialog, button, or input; reserve lg (8px) for header-chrome-style secondary controls and full for data-bearing chips only.
Do treat a disabled action with a dashed border, not a dimmed one.
donts: Don't touch the six clinical BP-category colors, the three overlay-dataset colors, or the chart-line colors for aesthetic reasons — they are locked medical/data identity.
Don't add a hover-only, drag, or precise-pointing interaction anywhere — the primary user cannot reliably operate a pointer.
Don't introduce a third font weight — only 400 and 700 ship as static files for Atkinson Hyperlegible; a synthesized weight is a regression, not an enhancement.

Don't let the Focus ring and Terracotta accent collapse into the same color again — they were deliberately separated in dark mode so a focused control and a pressed control are never visually confused.
Don't hardcode a hex value in a component. Every color is a var(--...) custom property declared once in index.css for both themes.
